purpose: Teach: コミットメント/印刷物/公職/増産/ふさわしく/簡略/お買い得/取り直し

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: プロジェクトへの、本気で、絶対、コミットメント、絶対、社員、絶対、強く、絶対、求めろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: I need absolute, unwavering commitment to this project from every member of the team. I'm counting on you.
lines.style: Clipped, measured authority. Each phrase lands with quiet weight. No rush—the words carry their own gravity. Steady eye contact. The tone of someone accustomed to being listened to.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内、本気で、絶対、印刷物、絶対、ペーパーレス化、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're moving forward on the paperless transition for internal operations with full commitment. Thank you for the direction.
lines.style: Respectful, efficient delivery. Formal register—the tone of someone reporting upward. Slight forward lean in posture. Each point clear and bracketed, no wasted words.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 公職、本気で、絶対、退いた方々、絶対、当社、絶対、お招き、絶対、検討しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: And I want you to consider reaching out to some of the retired executives in our network. Bring them in for consultation.
lines.style: Direct instruction, but warmer than the first request. Less barked, more conversational. Still commanding—this is not a suggestion. But there's room for strategy in the tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。需要に応じ、本気で、絶対、増産、絶対、体制、絶対、整えております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Understood. We're scaling up production infrastructure to match demand as it comes. Everything's in place.
lines.style: Quick, affirmative response. Calm and methodical. The rhythm of someone reporting progress on something already in motion. Professional, unbothered.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界に、本気で、絶対、ふさわしく、絶対、品位、絶対、保て、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Maintain our standards. Keep the company's dignity intact in everything we do—especially what the industry sees.
lines.style: Steady, almost quiet intensity. The words settle like a standard being planted. Not harsh, but non-negotiable. A pause before the final thought gives weight to 'dignity.'

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。書類、本気で、絶対、簡略、絶対、化、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're streamlining documentation across the board. The process is running smoothly.
lines.style: Crisp confirmation. Quick pace—efficient reporting. The tone of someone checking boxes competently. Professional neutrality, no flourish.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 仕入れの、本気で、絶対、お買い得、絶対、ルート、絶対、確保しろ、本気で、頼んだぞ
lines.en: Lock down our procurement routes. Find the cost-effective suppliers and secure them now. Don't wait on this.
lines.style: Decisive, forward-leaning. Urgency without panic. The 'now' lands firmly. Practical authority—this is about action, not discussion. Sharp consonants.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。CM撮影の、本気で、絶対、取り直し、絶対、対応、絶対、進めております、本気で、感謝
lines.en: Yes. We're coordinating the ad shoot retakes. All handling is already underway.
lines.style: Final confirmation, slightly shorter than the others—the conversation winding down. Still formal, but a fraction less elaborate. The closing note of someone signing off.
